messages:
Maya: Quick plan — launching the benchmark report + webinar next Wed. We want a 3-wave newsletter: pre-announcement, launch (report + webinar invite), follow-up (record + CTA). Need segmentation + send windows for NA/EU/APAC. Who can own segmentation + HubSpot routing? :rocket:

Tom: I can own segmentation. Proposed cohorts:
1) Product trial users (high intent)
2) API explorers (medium)
3) Newsletter-only (low)

Send windows: NA noon-2pm PT, EU 10-12am CET, APAC 10-12am SGT. Stagger waves by 48h. I'll prepare lists and upload to our shared bucket by EOD.

Jules: I'll iterate subject lines and preheaders. Quick options to start A/B tests:
- "New benchmark: inference cost at 1/3 the price"
- "Webinar: reduce LLM latency — live demo"
- "How we optimize inference for production"

I recommend testing Subject A vs Subject B for cohorts 1 & 2.

Eli: Webinar RSVP form needs hidden field for cohort tag + UTM. Add this to all links: `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&cohort={{cohort}}`

Zoe: HubSpot routing notes: if cohort=product_trial then assign to SDR queue `Launch-high`. If `demo_requested=1` then trigger immediate webhook to `/hooks/rtp`. Also recommend adding lead score +40 to create a follow-up task. I can build the workflows once cohorts are finalized.

Maya: Targets for launch: open >= 25% (cohort1), CTR >= 6%, demo signups >= 2% from cohort1. Daily report at 10am PT for first 5 days. Dashboard link: https://app.redwood.ai/dashboards/benchmark-launch

Tom: Upload plan: place CSVs in `marketing/uploads/` with filename pattern `benchmark_wave{n}_{cohort}.csv`. Required columns: email, first_name, cohort, timezone. Example CSV snippet:
```
email,first_name,cohort,timezone
sam@acme.com,Sam,product_trial,PT
```

Jules: Small ask — throttle newsletter-only cohort to 1 email/week to avoid fatigue. Also need APAC-specific short copy (condensed subject + bullets).

Maya: Agreed — cohort3 = weekly only. APAC copy: shorter subject line + top 3 bullets.

Zoe: I'll set workflows and add tag `benchmark_launch_2026`. Will confirm when done.

Tom: Done uploading wave1 lists. gs://redwood-marketing/benchmark/wave1_prodtrial.csv :white_check_mark:

Jules: Draft copy & templates here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BenchDraft — please leave comments on tone + CTA.

Eli: I'll wire webinar CTA to calendar + enable recording capture. Need to confirm speakers and final agenda. Reminder cadence: 7d, 1d, 1h before event.

Maya: Speakers locked: Eli, Priya, and Samir. Agenda in the doc. Also prefer reminder emails to use a slightly different subject (short + urgency).

Tom: Routing question — for users who opened but didn't click, we should retarget in wave2 with a different CTA (record or quick explainer). OK?

Maya: Yes — retarget strategy approved. For cohort1 use stronger demo CTA, cohort2 get record + highlights.

Zoe: HubSpot implementation note — retarget exports will run daily 3am PT to `retarget/wave1_open_no_click.csv`. Set workflow to add to wave2 audience.

Sam: Taking notes and can help with uploads, QA, and the A/B test tracking sheet.

Maya: Awesome — thanks, team. I'll ping when the dashboard and final schedule are live. :thumbsup:
